fit_reason: Although marked as a private seller, the photos and text show this is dealer stock from Ameri Cars LLC in Osseo, MN, shot on their lot with dealer signage and a dealer plate frame, so it is not a private owner sale.
findings: Paint on the hood, doors and rear hatch looks glossy with clear reflections
Light hazing visible on the passenger-side headlight lens
Dealer sticker on the rear quarter window and tailgate
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the black Grand Cherokee. The paint already looks sharp, and the passenger headlight lens has a little haze we could clear up. We do mobile detailing and headlight restoration and come to you. Would you like a quote?
